structure LegacyCost (B:Binding C)(J:ChartRatio G)(w z:ℝ)(ξ:Purse)(k u D :ℕ)(O:HaarBudget G)(l r:ℝ):Prop where
    moves: Launch C k ξ w z
    age : Charge C.path.levels ξ.band k u O ξ.era
    hours : ShowHours J B ξ k w l r
    token : Vents B ξ J l r k
    clears : Eark (prepared C.path.levels.clock.kernel) u (C.path.levels.clock.J k) D ξ.taylor ξ.band (wheel C.path.levels k) (clim C.path.levels k)
    room (n:ℕ)(h:n ≤ u): Caff (G:=G) ξ (clim AX k) (k-middle AX ξ.band k) u n
    tariff (n:ℕ)(h:n ≤ u): ∀ x∈ Set.Icc ((clim AX k)/2) (clim AX k), ∀ y∈ Set.Icc ((clim AX k)/2) (clim AX k), ∀ P R : BudgetPoint,P.B=walls y → R.B=walls x→TimeBand ξ.era ξ.goal ((AX).clock.factor ((AX).clock.J k)) P R x y (clim AX k) n

proof_context.conclusion: The window's accumulated source cost and ratio conditions are bundled as hypotheses (`hours`, `token`, `tariff`) of `LegacyCost`, supplied by `Poised.supply`.

structure Poised (n:ℕ)(z:ℝ)(k:ℕ)(t:ℕ→ℕ→TableL C D):Prop where
    early : ∀ d,d ≤ D → C.ref d ≤ k
    limit : wheel A k ≤ (A).clock.monitor k
    charts : ∀ N p, k < N→ Charting D k (t N p) N p
    supply (χ:ι) : ∃ l r,∃ h:LegacyCost B J (-3) z ((P χ).bag ((A).clock.J k)) k n D O l r,∀ N p (hx:k<N),∃ V,Actum B H O J (P χ) h V hx ∧ ∀ d:Fin (D+1),∃ L:StampDuty C k N p d ((P χ).bag ((A).clock.J k)).taylor V ((P χ).bag ((A).clock.J k)).era.coast.Q (stamp A N p),L.T=t N p d

proof_context.conclusion: `Poised` requires a `LegacyCost` at level k for every panel.
